name: Spondyloarthritis-Associated Enthesitis
definition: Inflammation at tendon or ligament insertions, commonly affecting Achilles, plantar fascia and other entheses in the spondyloarthritis spectrum.

typical: May coexist with psoriasis, IBD or axial symptoms

investigations.principle: Diagnosis is clinical; ultrasound/MRI may demonstrate active enthesitis in selected cases.
investigations.MRI: Use MRI when soft-tissue, neural, marrow, occult injury, infection or other condition-specific questions require it.
investigations.radiographs: Use radiographs and/or CT according to the condition-specific imaging pathway.

amber: Persistent inflammatory enthesitis may require systemic therapy rather than repeated local procedures.
red: Urgent red-flag features override routine conservative or Ayurvedic pathways.

ayurvedaFramework.text: Snayu/Sandhi Shotha phenotype may be documented only in parallel with inflammatory classification.

patientEducation.summary: Inflammation at tendon or ligament insertions, commonly affecting Achilles, plantar fascia and other entheses in the spondyloarthritis spectrum.
patientEducation.urgent: Seek urgent assessment for major trauma, acute/progressive neurological deficit, severe infection/systemic illness, vascular compromise or other listed red flags.
